text:
hana: Pushed a doc PR to tidy the Quickstart container example and clarify auth for local docker runs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1452 :sparkles:

leo: Nice! main things i looked for: clear env var name, example Dockerfile CMD that reads from env, and a one-liner showing how to pass the key at docker run time.

hana: yep updated Dockerfile to show `ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY` + example `CMD [\"sh\",\"-c\",\"node app.js\"]` and added `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY redwood-hello` example.

sam: can we also include a short python snippet? a lot of users use python for quickstarts. even a 2-line requests example.

hana: added tiny python example using `requests.post(\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\", json=payload, headers=headers)` — kept it minimal.

ryan: small nit: in the node snippet you reference `@redwoodai/sdk` but our package scope is `@redwood/inference-sdk` in the new SDK naming. worth syncing with package.json team?

hana: good catch. i used legacy import by mistake. i'll switch to `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk'` and note `npm i @redwood/inference-sdk@^6.0.0`.

leo: also suggest making the docker command show `--env-file .env` option for users who prefer not to inline keys.

hana: added `--env-file .env` example and a short sentence about not committing .env to git.

ci-bot: github checks queued for PR #1452: lint, linkcheck, doctests.

hana: i created an anchor link to /docs/auth/getting-started to explain scopes, but linkcheck failed on preview earlier. decided to use absolute path to the guide.

ci-bot: lint: passed. linkcheck: failed (internal anchor mismatch). doctests: running but flagged one example needing mocking.

sam: We recently added a docs test helper for container examples — see PR #1448. If that lands, doctests should pass. Can we mark this PR to rerun after #1448 merges?

hana: yes i'll add a note to the PR description: "blocked on docs test helper (#1448) for container mocking".

ryan: tiny content suggestion: call out that REDWOOD_API_KEY is preferred for new quickstarts and add a deprecation note for REDWOOD_TOKEN used in older samples.

hana: added a small deprecation note: "REDWOOD_TOKEN deprecated; use REDWOOD_API_KEY for new projects".

leo: also add troubleshooting: if docker container responds 401, check env file syntax and container clock (systemd containers sometimes drift).

hana: added Troubleshooting: "401 Unauthorized: ensure REDWOOD_API_KEY present, check .env formatting, and verify host/container clock".

doc-bot: summary: PR #1452 updates quickstart docker example, adds env-file guidance, adds python snippet, fixes SDK import to @redwood/inference-sdk, marks legacy REDWOOD_TOKEN deprecated, and adds troubleshooting. Blocked awaiting docs test helper (#1448) to satisfy doctests.

sam: tagging @leo @ryan for a quick final glance once CI green. :thumbsup:

leo: ack, will do a quick final sweep.

hana: thanks y'all — will re-run checks after #1448 merges and ping reviewers. :shipit:
